name: SMTP Email Forward Pattern
description: Forward emails via SMTP with optional prefix
explanation:
Pattern for forwarding emails via SMTP.

Key settings:
- mode: 'forward' (forward existing email)
- to: Recipient email address
- addPrefix: Subject prefix (e.g., '[Forwarded]', '[Customer Support]')

Forward mode uses context.currentEmail automatically in ForEach loop.

Alternative mode: 'send'
- mode: 'send' (compose new email)
- to: Recipient email
- subject: Email subject
- body: Email body (supports {{context.xxx}} variables)

Template variables:
- {{context.currentEmail.from}}: Original sender
- {{context.currentEmail.subject}}: Original subject

Setup: Configure SMTP connection in Connections settings.
